000017680: “If the shoes and clothing of the labourer, could, by improvements in machinery, be produced by one fourth of the labour”是设例。它不断言1817年之后鞋和衣服的劳动真会降到四分之一，工资随后调整也只在这个如果句里。
000018209: “If these improvements extended to all the objects of the labourer's consumption”把同一设例扩到劳动者的全部消费品。短短几年后的享受是这个如果句的比较结果，不是待核验的未来。
000029604: “Economy in the use of labour never fails to reduce the relative value of a commodity”是节省劳动必降低该商品相对价值的普遍说法。它不是1817年之后某一种商品相对价格的未定结果。
000033740: “profits would be high or low, exactly in proportion as wages were low or high”把利润写成工资的恰好反比。这是同一时点的分配关系，不是两条后来的序列。
000040058: “A rise of wages would not raise them in money value”限于生产不再追加劳动、固定资本与流动资本比例相同、耐久性也相同。这是工资上升当下的比较静态。
000040620: “If the fixed and circulating capitals were in different proportions, or if the fixed capital were of different durability”只说构成或耐久性不同时相对价值会改变。两个 if 都是假设。
000043725: “with every rise of wages”按流动资本所占比例，比较一个行业与另一个行业的相对价值。比较发生在工资上升的同一关系里。
000052895: “the relative prices of those commodities on which such capital is employed, will vary inversely as wages”按固定资本的数量和耐久性，把相对价格写成与工资反向。这仍是比较静态。
000053183: “no commodities whatever are raised in absolute price, merely because wages rise”否认工资上升本身抬高绝对价格，并说没有追加劳动就不会涨。这是价格定律。
000060923: “commodities may be lowered in value in consequence of a real rise of wages, but they never can be raised from that cause”只断定真实工资上升不能成为价值上升的原因。
000066641: “When, in the progress of society, land of the second degree of fertility is taken into cultivation, rent immediately commences on that of the first quality”是次等土地入耕时头等土地开始有地租的理论步骤。
000067303: “With every step in the progress of population, which shall oblige a country to have recourse to land of a worse quality”把更肥沃土地的地租上升系于被迫使用更差土地的每一步。
000069541: “In such case, capital will be preferably employed on the old land, and will equally create a rent”的 such case 指前文情形。资本留在旧地并产生地租，没有单独的日后对象。
000071882: “When land of an inferior quality is taken into cultivation, the exchangeable value of raw produce will rise, because more labour is required to produce it”用更多劳动解释交换价值上升，是入耕机制。
000074030: “the comparative value of that produce will continue permanently above its former level”因为劣地需要更多劳动，而且追加的原料只从这种地得来。这是上一机制的延续。
000076971: “The rise of rent is always the effect of the increasing wealth of the country, and of the difficulty of providing food”把地租上升写成财富增加和食物困难的结果，是因果同一性。
000078847: “with every portion of additional capital which it becomes necessary to employ on the land with a less productive return, rent would rise”地租随报酬更低的追加资本上升。
000079410: “Population regulates itself by the funds which are to employ it, and therefore always increases or diminishes with the increase or diminution of capital”是人口随资本基金增减的一般表述。
000079836: 资本减少的逆序才写出“Land of a less unproductive quality will be in succession relinquished”。较差土地被放弃、交换价值下降、最后耕种的好地不付地租，并不断言1817年之后资本会减少。
000080579: “if an improvement be afterwards discovered by which it can be raised on No. 1 and 2, without employing No. 3”用第1、2号地不再使用第3号地的设例，直接效果是地租下降。
000081912: “It is only, however, after the increase in the population, that rent would be as high as before”仍在该改良设例中：要等第3号地重新入耕，地租才回到原来的高度，中间一段地租更低。
000083780: “If, by the introduction of the turnip husbandry, or by the use of a more invigorating manure, I can obtain the same produce with less capital”用萝卜轮作或更有效肥料的设例说明地租会降低。
000085992: “though they will lower the money rent of land”的 they 是前面那一类改良，不是一项已经发生、只等以后观察的改良。
000087620: “whatever diminishes the inequality in the produce obtained from successive portions of capital”降低地租，扩大这种不均等就提高地租。这是用连续资本的报酬差定义地租。
000089781: “All that the other mines produce more than this, will necessarily be paid to the owners for rent”把超过最贫矿的产量定义为必须付给矿主的地租。
000090775: “In either of these cases the metals would fall in value”两种情形都是假设。金属交换到的其他物品减少，不是已经触发的结果。
000090899: “from the increasing difficulty of obtaining the metal, occasioned by the greater depth at which the mine must be worked, and the accumulation of water, or any other contingency”只说价值可能显著上升。might 留在这些偶然困难上。
000095092: “This restless desire on the part of all the employers of stock, to quit a less profitable for a more advantageous business, has a strong tendency to equalize the rate of profits”写的是利润被拉平的倾向。
000098159: “if any cause should elevate the profits of one of these trades 10 per cent.”某行业利润高出一成时，这个高出或者是暂时的，或者其他行业也按同一比例上升。百分之十是设例。
000098817: “Suppose now, that a change of fashion should increase the demand for silks, and lessen that for woollens”用时尚从呢绒转向丝绸的假设，说明市场价格和利润暂时分开，自然价格不变。
000102157: “With a rise in the price of food and necessaries, the natural price of labour will rise; with the fall in their price, the natural price of labour will fall”是劳动自然价格随食物和必需品价格升降的定义。
000102320: “the natural price of labour has always a tendency to rise”把劳动自然价格随社会进步上升写成一直存在的倾向，因为调节它的一种主要商品倾向变贵。
000102910: “The natural price of all commodities excepting raw produce and labour has a tendency to fall, in the progress of wealth and population”是除原料和劳动以外的自然价格倾向。
000104016: “wages again fall to their natural price, and indeed from a re-action sometimes fall below it”是高工资鼓励人口增加之后，市场工资回到自然价格、有时落到其下的机制。
000106391: “in both cases the market rate of wages will rise”的 both cases 是前文两种资本增加。市场工资随劳动需求上升，是这些情形里的比例。
000107636: “with every improvement of society, with every increase in its capital, the market wages of labour will rise; but the permanence of their rise will depend”市场工资上升能否持久，取决于工资所购买的必需品的自然价格是否也上升。
000108794: “From manufactured commodities always falling, and raw produce always rising, with the progress of society”把制成品永远下降、原料永远上升写成社会进步中的一般对照。
000111168: “it will not long continue so”的 so 是最有利情形下生产能力暂时超过人口。土地数量有限且质量不同，所以这种有利状态在理论上不能长久。
000112277: “Every exertion of industry, unless accompanied by a diminished rate of increase in the population, will add to the evil, for production cannot keep pace with it”没有人口增速下降的勤劳会加重祸害。unless 是人口原理里的条件。
000114675: “In the natural advance of society, the wages of labour will have a tendency to fall, as far as they are regulated by supply and demand”劳动者供给仍按原速度增加，对劳动的需求增加得更慢。这是供求倾向。
000115634: “As population increases, these necessaries will be constantly rising in price, because more labour will be necessary to produce them”必需品涨价被写成生产它们需要更多劳动的直接结果。
000117083: “if money be of an unvarying value, both rent and wages will have a tendency to rise with the progress of wealth and population”货币价值不变才把地租和工资写成随财富与人口有上升倾向。
000117821: “he will receive more money wages, it is true, but his corn wages will be reduced”放在地租与工资的差别里：地主的谷物地租增加，劳动者的谷物工资减少。这是同一步分配比较。
000118131: “While the price of corn rises 10 per cent., wages will always rise less than 10 per cent., but rent will always rise more”用谷物上涨一成时工资涨得更少、地租涨得更多来比较三个份额。一成是比例设例。
000122967: “the rise of wages will not raise the prices of commodities, whether the metal from which money is made be produced at home or in a foreign country”工资上升不抬高物价，不论货币金属产于国内还是外国。
000126101: “By gradually contracting the sphere of the poor laws ... we shall by degrees approach a sounder and more healthful state”是收缩济贫法、让穷人依靠自己的规范主张。we shall 不是现行法已经注定的结果。
000128280: “the tendency of such laws to change wealth and power into misery and weakness”把提供安逸的那类法律比作重力，直到各阶级只顾生存。such laws 是这一类法律的倾向。
000131567: “will not compensate him for the rise of wages”原料价格只按地租或追加人数的比例上升，补偿不了农场主多付的工资。这是该计算中的比较。
000133016: “although the value of the labourer's portion will be increased by the high value of food, his real share will be diminished”食物变贵时劳动者那一份的价值增加、真实份额减少，地主的价值与数量都增加。
000141107: “But the rate of profits will fall still more, because the capital of the farmer”利润率下降更多，原因停在农场主的资本上。这是数例中未完的比较，没有给出后来要核对的利润率。
000142535: “Cotton goods, linen, and cloth, will all rise in price with the rise of wheat”棉织品、亚麻和呢绒随小麦上涨。这句话留在同一张分配数例里。
000146466: 时尚或其他突然原因使需求增加或供给减少时，“The makers of cloth will for a time have unusual profits”，然后价格回到40先令。40先令是例子里的公平水平。
000147672: “The natural tendency of profits then is to fall”因为社会与财富进步时，追加的食物要牺牲愈来愈多的劳动。这是利润的自然倾向，不是一条已完结的利润率。
000148329: “as soon as wages should be equal (as in the case formerly stated) to 720l.”工资等于农场主全部进款720镑时，积累停止，人口达到最高点。720镑是前面的数例。
000148800: “the labourers, will be the property of the owners of land and the receivers of tithes and taxes”承接720镑那一终点，产品归于地主以及什一税和税收的收取者。
000151690: “will cease altogether when their profits are so low as not to afford them an adequate compensation for their trouble”积累动机随利润降低，低到不够补偿麻烦和风险就停止。
000155453: “When the accumulation of capital, however, becomes very great”尽管价值增加，分到利润的价值比以前少，分到地租和工资的增加。when 是积累已经很大的那个比较。
000158093: “Whilst the land yields abundantly, wages may temporarily rise”生产者可能暂时消费得更多，但人口受到的刺激会迅速把劳动者拉回通常消费。
000158349: “But when poor lands are taken into cultivation, or when more capital and labour are expended on the old land, with a less return of produce, the effect must be permanent”贫地或报酬下降使前面的暂时效果变成持久效果。
000159603: “where the land is of a poor quality, and where the importation of food is prohibited”土地贫瘠而且禁止进口食物的地方，温和的积累也带来利润大降和地租速升。这是一种地方类型。
000161535: “a rise of wages would not raise the price of commodities, but would invariably lower profits”工资上升不抬高商品价格，而降低利润。这是又一次写出的比较静态。
000161898: “No extension of foreign trade will immediately increase the amount of value in a country”对外贸易的扩张不会立刻增加价值量，虽然会增加商品量和享受。这是价值与享受的一般区分。
000164477: “the profits of the favoured trade will speedily subside to the general level”受特惠的行业利润会迅速回到一般水平。这是利润均等，不是某一个被点名的行业在1817年之后的利润账。
000166449: “If one increases, the other must diminish.”一方增加则另一方必减。这句话没有给出1817年之后要增加的是哪一方。
000170648: “If, therefore, by the extension of foreign trade, or by improvements in machinery, the food and necessaries of the labourer can be brought to market at a reduced price, profits will rise”食物和必需品因外贸或机器而更便宜时利润上升。这是如果句。
000171089: “if the commodities obtained at a cheaper rate ... be exclusively the commodities consumed by the rich, no alteration will take place in the rate of profits”更便宜的若只是富人消费品，利润率不变。
000171777: “has no tendency to raise the profits of stock, unless the commodities imported be of that description on which the wages of labour are expended”进口品不是工资所花费的那一类时，没有提高利润的倾向。
000174301: “If the profits of capital employed in Yorkshire, should exceed those of capital employed in London, capital would speedily move from London to Yorkshire”约克郡利润高于伦敦时资本会移走并拉平。这是地区设例。
000174507: “it would not follow that capital and population would necessarily move from England to Holland, or Spain, or Russia”英格兰报酬下降、工资升而利润降，并不因此必然引起资本和人口外迁。否定的是这个必然推论。
000195238: “Thus we have seen, that ... corn must rise in relative value to other things.”依次耕种更差的土地推出谷物相对价值必升；只有“If therefore money continue permanently of the same value”才进一步说到货币价格。这是已经作出的推论。
000212621: “The necessity of cultivating poorer land, or of obtaining a less return with a given additional capital on land already in cultivation, will inevitably raise the exchangeable value of raw produce”再次把原料交换价值的上升写成耕种更贫瘠土地或报酬下降的必然结果。
000218153: “From the effect of the principle of population on the increase of mankind, wages of the lowest kind never continue much above that rate which nature and habit demand”用人口原理说明赋税为何提高最低种类工资所不能长期超出的生活标准。这是常设原理，不是另一条平均实际工资。
000226738: “It generally happens indeed, that when a stimulus has been given to population, an effect is produced beyond what the case requires”人口往往增加过度，随后发生反作用，工资回落。generally happens 是这个反复机制。
000251641: “as society improves in wealth, they must, though the same proportion of the gross produce, become a larger and larger portion of the net produce”什一税占毛产品的比例不变，占纯产品的比例随社会变富而增大。这是毛产品与纯产品的会计推论。
000262058: “Such a state of taxation could not be long endured”的 such 指年复一年减少一国资本的课税。同一段写这种课税在任何自由国家都还没有发生。不能长久忍受，是对那个状态说的，不是断言它已经到来。
000543294: “this power would be more likely to be abused, if in the hands of Government, than if in the hands of a banking company”比较纸币发行权放在政府或银行公司手里哪一边更易滥用。两个 if 是制度安排的反事实。
000562947: “a rich country is prevented from increasing in population, in the same ratio as a poor country, by the progressive difficulty of providing food”富国不能按穷国的比例增加人口，食物困难必提高食物的相对价格并鼓励进口。这是富国与穷国的一般比较。
000570423: “I have endeavoured to shew that it will be low in rich countries, and high in poor countries”作者要表明的是：用谷物估计，黄金在富国价值低、在穷国价值高。这是和亚当·斯密对照的理论命题。
000570749: “gold will not necessarily be lower in those countries which are in possession of the mines”黄金在拥有矿山的国家并不必然更低。not necessarily 否定的是必然更低，不是一份矿区物价。
000596996: “The increase of population, and the increase of food will generally be the effect, but not the necessary effect of high wages”人口和食物增加通常跟着高工资，但这句写明那不是必然结果。
000597847: “in practice it is invariably found that an increase of population follows the amended condition of the labourer”实践中总是看到劳动者境况改善之后人口增加。invariably found 是从已有实践作出的归纳。
000598328: “because the number of people is increased, that wages again fall”人数已经增加，所以工资再降。because 把工资下降写成前一机制的后续，没有另给观察终点。
000605281: “The rise of rent and wages, and the fall of profits, are generally the inevitable effects of the same cause”地租上升、工资上升和利润下降通常来自同一原因：对食物的需求增加、生产食物需要更多劳动、食物因而昂贵。
000613532: “By allowing the free importation of corn, or by improvements in agriculture, raw produce would fall”自由进口谷物或农业改良会使原料下降，其他商品只按所含原料生产成本下降的比例变动。By allowing 是政策比较。
000617868: “with every fall in the real value of necessaries, the wages of labour would fall, and that the profits of stock would rise”必需品真实价值每下降一次，工资下降、资本利润上升。
000618731: “is very highly probable”出现在回答马尔萨斯的地方：马尔萨斯把谷物下跌写成名义收入减半。工资会和其他商品一样下降，地主、农场主、制造业者、商人和公债持有人剩下的净收入仍和以前一样大。这是对那个假设跌幅的判断。
000623502: “if it fall still more, the price will not afford even the common profits of stock; capital will then quit the land”价格再降到普通利润也没有时，资本离开土地，原先种在那里的谷物才进口。if it fall still more 接在地租被吸尽之后。
000623822: “there will be a gain of wealth”地租损失带来估计货币价值的损失；因为生产更容易，原料和其他产品的数量增加、价值减少。这是前一句进口论证的推论。
000639133: “I do not believe, that if bread were taxed, the consumption of bread would be diminished, more than if cloth, wine, or soap, were taxed”对面包征税与对布、酒或肥皂征税的消费比较是反事实。
000658033: “Such a regulation would be extremely pernicious, and would expose us to considerable and unnecessary variation in the bullion value of the currency”这种规章会造成不必要的变动。Such a regulation 不是已经点名的1816年铸币法。
000662582: “money would not continue of the same value,--that it would fall, from increased importation”货币不会保持同一价值，而会因进口增加下降。这是注文里的假设。
